DHI.title: Dior Homme Intense — PW Iris–Ambrette R1
DHI.exact_claim: PW-product-based architectural development interpretation; not an authentic quantitative Dior reconstruction
DHI.target_edition: Current/long-running Intense iris–ambrette architecture, with user-selected root-led constraint; not exact 2011 batch
DHI.target_basis: 100 parts undiluted perfume-product equivalents by mass; not 100 parts pure odorant molecules

rows.selection_reason: chose a softer transparent frame; stronger woody products are not interchangeable grades
current owned AIMI is exact PW identity; Gamma Coeur is distinct and depleted; Irotyl is excluded by the DHI brief

rows.functional_hypothesis: space between iris, opening and musk
rows.selection_reason: regular Hedione is a restrained bridge; HC requires its own dose and muguet would change the heart
targets DHI's fruity-musky facet without adding a literal pear-candy accord
chosen for roundness rather than metallic brightness
chosen as a low-cost quiet body; not a claimed substitute for either other musk
acetate and whole oil do different jobs; grade and composition stay separate
modest smooth support; Polysantol is depleted locally and not silently substituted
gentler aromatic curve than bitter pith or lemon; FCF is not a safety certificate
less blue-fresh architecture; not evidence of an original Dior ingredient
brand declarations support presence of linalyl acetate, not this quantity
the generic PW lavender lot must be smelled; camphor and provenance are not assumed identical to any owned lavender
small complementary opening edge; omission test must establish that it earns its place
Virginia product selected for DHI's declared cedar axis; other species are not exact equivalents
keeps root-to-wood contrast; Orivone catalog price/availability was not established and berry emphasis is restrained
different from alpha irone; supports petal contrast rather than replacing natural root
PW grade chosen explicitly; the page's irone claim is not a lot assay and bases are not equivalent
not interchangeable with ionone; dose is a product-level hypothesis, not a pure enantiomer calibration
weighing a defined product avoids pretending an opaque tonka base has known coumarin content
regular vanillin instead of a stronger vanilla or candy register; not automatically increased for richness
low target-linked texture, not a large balsamic perfume
exact resinoid product, not an unassayed starting-resin tincture; compare omission with labdanum
clearer grade hypothesis; neither pure patchoulol nor original Dior grade is asserted
whole-oil texture is kept separate from the smoother acetate; excessive smokiness fails the brief
crystal mass remains separate; no superamber blanket substitution and no huge Ambrox premise
bounded low dose, not a dominant cashmere/amberwood perfume
high-risk optional nuance; vegetable, salty or cumin-like drift rejects it
not chemically or sensorially identical to Dior's purified ambrette essence; low-dose omission comparison required
restrained high-impact accent; no plum or rose recognizer should emerge

thirty_g_20pct_ww.basis: 20% w/w product-equivalent design loading; NOT a 30 mL volume assertion

thirty_ml_20pct_wv.alcohol_operation: Add perfumer alcohol to measured final volume 30.0 mL after homogeneous mixing and temperature equilibration; do not add a fixed 24 mL
thirty_ml_20pct_wv.basis: 20 g perfume-product equivalents per 100 mL, w/v, NOT w/w

rounded_five_g_trial.note: Uses homogeneous master made from rounded stock card; these are calculations under nominal stock fractions, not measurements

DHI.cost_scope: Listing arithmetic only; excludes perfumer alcohol, bottles, minimum buys, handling, shipping, tax and checkout currency; not a cart
DHI.user_stock_reuse_note: Reuse only the same product at a confirmed mass fraction. The owned Orris Liquid 9% w/w DEP and alpha-irone 10% w/w DEP can be recalculated by weighing; matrix changes remain explicit, and formula labels alone do not establish preparations.

recognizers: fine cedar and restrained sweet warmth
negative_space: no blue-fresh or giant amberwood structure
locked_brief.time_profile: aromatic/pear-musky lift → iris cosmetic/root heart → fine musky cedar warmth
locked_brief.claim_limit: Exact Dior formula and exact 2011-batch similarity are not established

existing_confirmed_iris_stock_alternativ.known_matrix_change: Replace neat Orris with 9% w/w DEP stock; replace alpha-irone 10% w/w DPG with same-fraction DEP stock. Product masses preserve exactly; carriers do not.
existing_confirmed_iris_stock_alternativ.stock_mass_precision: Repeating decimals shown to 9 places; bench rounding/measurement must be recorded, not concealed
